_comment: Hand-maintained per (set, product) sheet routing (§3.2). 'slots' maps a raw booster-sheet name to the v2 layout slot label(s) it feeds — a string for the normal case, an array when one physical sheet legitimately rides more than one slot (e.g. a set's dual-purpose land/wildcard sheet). 'topper' names the box-topper sheet and its hand-sourced expected copies/box (ratePerBox is not in MTGJSON — WotC/community-sourced); null when the product ships no box topper. Seed sets beyond EOE land in S3b.
